history.summary: A freehold walk-up apartment in D13 marketed purely on en-bloc hope at $1.3M / $1589 PSF, with no project name, no built_year and no URA data. En-bloc is a binary, low-probability lottery — paying $1589 PSF for an old walk-up on that bet, without facilities or a lift, is a speculative wager, not an investment thesis.
history.rating_rationale: The entire pitch is 'Enbloc', which is speculative and rarely materialises within a 5-7yr hold; meanwhile you hold an old freehold walk-up with no lift, no facilities, 930m to Mattar MRT, and $1589 PSF is a full price for that profile. No project name, no built_year, no URA appreciation/txn data — nothing to underwrite value or trajectory. Weak Elo 1092 and 149-246 record. Holding cost with no rental efficiency and no confirmed en-bloc reserve price = poor risk/reward.
red_flags: En-bloc is the only thesis — speculative, low base rate, no confirmed reserve price

catalysts: Freehold land — collective-sale optionality if a developer bites
